notes.title: Dev Log #1 A Breath of Fresh Air
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, fellow gamers and survivors![/h1]

[h2]Developer Log: A Breath of Fresh Air[/h2]

This is the first of many developer logs where we'll keep you updated on the thrilling journey of "With Last Breath." Buckle up because we're about to take a twistier path than your GPS on a winding mountain road!

[h2]Shifting Horizons: Embracing the Open World[/h2]

"With Last Breath" was initially announced as a top-down action survival shooter with closed levels and a distinct arcade vibe. But, like all great heroes, sometimes we need to adapt and grow. Thanks to invaluable feedback from both gamers and business-savvy folks, we're shifting gears towards an open-world survival-craft adventure. Fear not, though! We're keeping the heart-pounding action intact and turbocharging it for an epic gameplay experience.

[h2]Introducing... Just Me![/h2]

Now, here's the funny twist: We've been casually referring to the "With Last Breath" team as "we," but guess what? It's just little ol' me, solo-developing this epic adventure! No pressure, right?

[h2]What's in Store: A Glimpse at Planned Features[/h2]

Now, let's dive into the juicy bits. Here's a sneak peek at the features we have planned:

1. Expanded Survival Aspects: Prepare to test your mettle in a relentless world where every decision counts.

2. A Treasure Trove of Items: Discover, craft, and wield a myriad of items, each with its unique purpose and power.

3. Survival Stats: Monitor thirst, fatigue, and other crucial stats to keep your wits sharp and your health intact.

4. Inventory Management: The key to survival is efficient organization. Choose your gear wisely and stay one step ahead of danger.

5. Changing Weather: Brace yourself for dynamic weather conditions that will challenge your survival skills.

6. Day-Night Cycle: Adapt to the ever-shifting time of day as you navigate the wilds.

In essence, we're packing "With Last Breath" with all the goodies a true survival game needs to offer, and then some!

In order to encourage you I've prepared small preview video of me running around some initial zones, there's more to come !

[previewyoutube=d6-WJBou2O4;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Survive and Thrive: Join Our Community[/h2]

So, if you're as pumped as we are to dive into this adventure, stay tuned for more updates, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes action right here. And, we'd love to have you join our ever-growing community, so make sure to hop onto our Discord server [url=https://discord.gg/f6jTGpjxJY]click me![/url] and chat with fellow survivors!

Stay sharp, stay creative, and always game on!

solo dev
Sole Survivor Developer of "With Last Breath"
